input.free_text_description: This system is a authentication platform that serves Admin, User roles. It manages core business objects including auth user, sys role, trip user, sys user. The platform provides capabilities for user details, base dao, crud dao. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage auth user records, so that I can track and organize auth user data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage sys role records, so that I can track and organize sys role data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage trip user records, so that I can track and organize trip user data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage sys user records, so that I can track and organize sys user data effectively.
